page.overview:
Who is Great Ape?

The Legendary Super Saiyan's |Ōzaru}} form is an alternate version of the Golden Great Ape state. Its user can attain the Super Saiyan 4 state.

It is always referred to just as Great Ape in all media.

The Legendary Super Saiyan Great Ape form appears the same as a Golden Great Ape, however, the color of its fur is emerald, like that of the Legendary Super Saiyan form after Broly broke his crown, and his head hair is spiked upwards.

Broly is shown attaining this form by absorbing Blutz Waves emitted from a green orb that appears in Hell during the Reborn Broly Saga in Dragon Ball Heroes. He later transforms back into the form after escaping to the Sacred World of the Kai, before mastering the form and further transforming into a Super Saiyan 4. The JM7 trailer for the game instead depicts Black Smoke Shenron transforming him into a Great Ape off-screen, though he immediately masters the form and transforms straight into Super Saiyan 4.
